description:
Which arXiv papers support a scientific statement, which contradict
    it, and which study it without deciding, each with the paper's own main
    claim quoted and the classifier's probability. Call this before asserting a
    scientific result, when a user asks whether something is established or
    disputed, or when two sources disagree. Candidates are papers whose title
    and abstract match the statement's words, plus papers Pith's connected
    record links to them as stating the same or a conflicting result; a paper
    that states the result in other words can be missed, so an empty answer
    is not evidence of absence. Reported supporters and contradictions agreed
    with two blind model families 110 times in 112
    (https://pith.science/connected-record).
